name: Public Speaking
description: Stage presence, executive opening hook, vocal modulation, audience retention, and closing impact.

dimensions.name: Opening Hook & Retention
dimensions.description: Capturing undivided audience attention within the first 15 seconds without platitudes.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Electrifying opening story, counter-intuitive insight, or provocative question.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Strong opening with minor conventional pleasantries ('Thank you for having me').
rubricCriteria.50-69: Generic, polite throat-clearing; audience attention wanes.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Boring administrative monologue; loses room immediately.

dimensions.name: Vocal Modulation & Projection
dimensions.description: Dynamic volume, pitch variation, deliberate dramatic pauses, resonance.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Masterful dynamic range; uses quiet pauses to command total silence; energetic peaks.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good vocal energy with occasional monotone stretches.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Monotone delivery; rushes through critical punchlines.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Mumbles, speaks in low monotone, or sounds robotic and detached.
